sources.title: The Barbegal water mill in its environment: archaeology and the economic and social history of antiquity
sources.actual_access: full article OCR; relevant passages pp.142 and 149–152 inspected
sources.relevance: p.149 explicitly argues for an Arles-only flour market from revised chronology; the 2018 study instead proposes harbour provisions from seasonal deposits. Earlier context-based inference is a credible rival, not a refutation of subsequently measured pauses.
sources.lineage: Excavation/environment study by a later coauthor of ANC-S03. Shared site and researcher; different evidential subset. Sellin and Benoit arguments mentioned inside it were not separately read.
sources.audit_disposition: Supports keeping ANC-K05 underdetermined, as already recorded.

search_scope: Targeted English/French searches for Barbegal hardtack/seasonality criticism and original urban-market scholarship. Also sought Ile-Ife autonomous-origin commentary; no separate contrary original was fully inspected there.
access_failures_or_limits: PMC live article returned browser check; preserved original XML inspected instead.
Cambridge Leveau page initially exposed metadata only; article OCR subsequently inspected at Academia.
Comet 1999 Persée page exposed introductory text/metadata, not the full argument; not used as substantive evidence.
Sellin 1983 original not obtained; bibliographic lead and Leveau discussion not treated as independently inspected Sellin evidence.
